integrity: Proof uses bounded stationary telegraph filter and exact covariance resolvent, checked against independent augmented-moment recursions; external independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary critical limiting diffusion only, not finite-size interacting-process law or nonstationary process; general literature priority is not independently certified. Fourth cumulants do not characterize arbitrary laws, but nonzero cumulant rules out Gaussianity and constant volatility proves the boundary case.
title: Exact fourth cumulant and unconditional dependence in a critically switching reinforced diffusion
